# IGBundle / ManifoldGL

IGBundle is an experimental research codebase exploring information-geometric and fiber-structured adapters for language models. The proposed geometric inductive bias remains a hypothesis. Current evidence does not establish improved task performance, learned hyperbolicity, or training/inference efficiency gains.

## Evidence at a glance

- Fixed-operator faithfulness audit: 6/6 checks passed for the tested configuration. This is not a measure of learned geometry or task quality.
- Default curvature telemetry is weight-invariant because its conformal factor is fixed; do not describe the reported curvature as learned.
- October 27, 2026 local multi-benchmark run: custom weighted index 61.1 for base Qwen2.5-7B, 60.0 for the merged cp300 checkpoint, and 64.7 for a reconstructed adapter composite. No individual paired benchmark comparison was statistically significant. The index is custom, subsets were small (8–98), and the reconstructed arm is not the original trained checkpoint.
- The exported cp300 weights in that run did not contain the runtime geometric adapter. The reconstructed arm grafted a surviving adapter trained on the base model onto cp300 and used a different loading/quantization path; this does not isolate a geometric effect.
- [October per-benchmark summary](benchmark-results/aa-index-2026-10-27.csv)
- Paired held-out token-NLL probe (20 September 2026; 24 examples × 64 tokens): frozen base 2.3188, geometric adapter A 1.9352, vanilla-LoRA control B 0.8187. B had lower NLL on 24/24 examples.
- The probe is not parameter matched (A: 4,160,713 trainable parameters; B: 585,728) and compares one geometric layer with 13 LoRA layers. It does not isolate a geometric effect and is not task accuracy.
- Historical ARC-Challenge zero-shot `acc_norm`: 54.86% for both the adapter and base on 1,172 items each. A separate historical ARC-AGI run solved 1/100 tasks.
- ARC-AGI Model-First Reasoning format compliance was 0/100; this prompt-format metric is unrelated to the 6/6 fixed-operator audit.
